name: Silent Seraph of Broken Praise
lore: A Hollow entity that silenced the Empyrean divine choir. It holds a sphere of absolute silence — the stolen song compressed into nothing. Around it float the husks of the choir, frozen mid-note, mouths open in songs they will never finish. The most peaceful and most terrifying boss — not rage, but silence.
visualDescription: 50-60ft Hollow entity with six dissolving void-mist wings. Broken divine mask, mouth sealed shut. Sphere of absolute silence. Shattered halo shards. Frozen choir husks. Gate stone in chest. Crumbled ziggurat in absolute stillness.
mapBehavior: Boss encounter — 4 phases: silence field, choir summon, halo shatter, silence compression
